promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The requested outcome is a bounded calculator behavior repair. Writes are limited to src/calculator.ts and test/calculator.test.ts; .env, .git/**, and bun.lock are protected. The requested validation command is bun test when appropriate. Exact expected behavior for decimal input, clear, and division by zero is not yet specified.

refinedBrief.goal: Repair calculator handling for decimal input, clear actions, and division by zero.
deliverables: Focused implementation changes within src/calculator.ts only.
Focused regression tests within test/calculator.test.ts only.
Run bun test when execution is appropriate.
constraints: Do not modify files outside src/calculator.ts and test/calculator.test.ts.
Do not infer unspecified calculator semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Decimal input, clear behavior, and division-by-zero behavior match the confirmed expected semantics.
Relevant focused tests pass via bun test.
nonGoals: Modifying dependencies, lockfiles, environment files, or Git metadata.

questions.prompt: What exact user-visible behavior should the calculator use for decimal input, clear, and division by zero?
questions.rationale: These semantics determine both the implementation and the regression tests; the request does not define them.

options.label: Standard calculator behavior
options.description: Allow one decimal point per operand; clear resets the current calculation; division by zero shows an error state that clears on the next entry.

options.label: Existing tests define it
options.description: Treat the current focused tests as the authoritative behavior contract, adding coverage only for demonstrated gaps.
